item.title: Why Salesforce and ERP implementations fail: it's rarely the software
item.description:
Most Salesforce, Oracle or SAP implementations don't fail because of the software. They fail because the company had no structure, no plan and no governance, and because nobody decided who would administer the system. Technology doesn't solve problems. It exposes them.

I'm Juan Manuel Garr
